title: Heat limits act on the 2 min CPU average: master status shows the latest sample and the mean
description: GY-3532: after two minutes of loop cycles over a fixture hwmon whose package holds 90-92C, master status shows the latest sample (92C) beside the 120 s mean (91C); since GY-3501 the reading halves the trial cap and holds no launch.

steps.name: master status shows the latest CPU sample and the 120 s mean, and no launch waits on them
